records.meaning: Finite purchase horizon and purchase-date index.
records.reconciliation: Retained unchanged across the comparison model and empirical chapters.

records.meaning: Positive asset purchase price observed at date t.
records.reconciliation: Retained; never use p_t for an evaluation price outside a purchase date.

records.meaning: Common positive terminal evaluation price.
records.repository_notation: P in most boundary notes; p_{n+1} in the impossibility theorem.
records.reconciliation: Standardize on P and state once that P equals p_{n+1} in the impossibility theorem's indexing convention.

records.meaning: Nonnegative exogenous deposit arriving at purchase date t.
records.reconciliation: Retained; never use D_t for a cash difference in the body because it is visually confusable with deposits.

records.meaning: Cash spent by strategy S on the asset at date t.
records.reconciliation: Rename repository purchase x_t to b_t^S in the manuscript so x or u can denote mean inputs without collision; every imported theorem must state this mapping.

records.meaning: Cash carried by strategy S immediately after its date-t purchase.
records.reconciliation: Use the strategy superscript whenever more than one policy appears; omit it only in a single-policy derivation.

records.meaning: Asset units held by strategy S immediately after date t.
records.reconciliation: Use an explicit strategy superscript in comparisons.

records.meaning: Cash-inclusive terminal wealth of strategy S at evaluation price P.
records.reconciliation: Retain horizon and evaluation-price arguments when stating comparisons; abbreviate only after both are fixed.

records.meaning: Corrected guarded, neutral guarded, and DCA policies.
records.repository_notation: c, 0, DCA, D, or T depending on the result.
records.reconciliation: Standardize policy superscripts to c, 0, and D; use T only as a local theorem placeholder explicitly defined as 0 or D.

records.meaning: Cumulative DCA units after date t.
records.reconciliation: Use Q_t^D in exposition; introduce A_t := Q_t^D only inside the compact guardrail proof if it materially shortens equations.

records.meaning: Protected DCA wealth fraction and its tolerated relative shortfall.
records.reconciliation: Retained; use lambda for coverage in algorithms and epsilon when naming epsilon-DCA safety.

records.meaning: Unit-coverage cushion Q_t^S minus lambda Q_t^D.
records.reconciliation: Retain K and add the strategy superscript when comparing guarded selectors.

records.meaning: Cash available before the date-t purchase, C_{t-1}^S plus d_t.
records.reconciliation: Add a strategy superscript when floors or purchases differ.

records.meaning: Sharp minimum date-t purchase required by the unit guardrail.
records.reconciliation: Show lambda on first definition and retain S whenever comparing policy-specific clipped floors.

records.meaning: Positive transform used by the source functional, corrected mean, and selector.
records.reconciliation: Retained; state positivity, finiteness, and any monotonicity assumptions at each result rather than globally strengthening them.

records.meaning: Corrected-mean parameters and their difference Delta = alpha - beta.
records.reconciliation: Rename the repository's d = alpha - beta to Delta because d_t is reserved for deposits; preserve d only inside verbatim source quotations.

records.meaning: Positive mean inputs and positive external weights.
records.reconciliation: Rename mean input x_i to u_i to avoid collision with repository purchase outlay x_t; retain w_i.

records.meaning: Corrected out quasi-Gini mean, including its diagonal extension.
records.reconciliation: Only the input letter changes from x to u; the hat and out qualifier remain mandatory to distinguish the correction from the source functional.

records.meaning: Lagged dimensionless corrected-mean reference, current relative price, and discretionary score.
records.reconciliation: Retained; state the p_1 anchor and first-date neutral warm-up before use.

records.meaning: Corrected-minus-comparator terminal cash and unit differences.
records.reconciliation: Retained; T must be declared as DCA or the neutral guarded selector before each theorem use.

records.meaning: Corrected-minus-comparator carried-cash difference at date t.
records.reconciliation: Standardize on Delta C to avoid confusing repository D_t with deposits d_t or DCA superscript D.

records.meaning: Two-purchase price ratio p_2/p_1, evaluation ratio P/p_2, and half-discretionary factor (1-lambda)/2.
records.reconciliation: Retained as theorem-local shorthand only; delta never replaces Delta = alpha - beta.

records.meaning: Three-purchase ratio p_3/p_2.
records.reconciliation: Retained as theorem-local shorthand.

records.meaning: Relative terminal-wealth gap (W^S-W^T)/W^T in empirical tables.
records.repository_notation: relative_wealth_gap and several local gap symbols
records.reconciliation: Reserve g for empirical relative gaps outside the finite-horizon theorem sections, where local g has a different exact definition and must be explicitly scoped.

records.meaning: Total asset spending divided by acquired units for strategy S.
records.reconciliation: Introduce AC only as an accounting quantity and never use it as a substitute for cash-inclusive terminal wealth.
